svg.title: Transporting the same arrow along two paths on a sphere
svg.desc: A north-pointing arrow is parallel transported from P on the equator to Q, 90 degrees east. Along the equator, it still points north at Q. Via the North Pole, without rotating the arrow at the pole, it points east at Q. The two final vectors are 90 degrees apart.

g.font-family: Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif
g.text: Transport the same north-pointing arrow along two paths
P and Q lie on the equator. Q is 90° east of P.
Compare arrows in the tangent plane at Q
Blue: along the equator, still pointing north.
Orange: via the North Pole, pointing east.
Do not rotate the arrow when the path turns.
